dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: What does she know? All of our teas are valuable! What's wrong with taking it slow?

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is really ticking me off. She acts like I'm dragging my feet unloading the cargo, but it doesn't take that much time! What does she want me to do, toss the boxes straight down on the ground?

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: My tea is the most valuable cargo on this entire ship. If even a single box is damaged during unloading, I have to foot the bill, and I'm not holding out hope for any kind of reimbursement from her.

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: She doesn't know the first thing about this merchandise. It's enough to make me tear my hair out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these tea leaves very valuable?

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: These are all the finest teas from Qiaoying Village! Whether in terms of ingredients or processing, they simply can't be beat!

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: I really can't be bothered to argue with that ignorant fool.

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: Let's not talk about it for now. I'll have to reason with her later.
